render_source: Actual Blender Eevee rendering of the closed-shoulder Tripo mesh; no image repainting or generated substitute.
confirmed: Full T-pose, hands, horns, feet, wings and single curved tail remain visible in the full-body views.
White blouse covers the shoulders and joins the sleeves; the previous exposed-shoulder openings have not returned.
Source colors are preserved with clear pale-lavender hair/wing shading, banded clothing shadows and fine muted outlines.
The face, eyes and mouth remain readable; no new large black outline-hull patches obscure the face.
Rear hair and tail are readable with fine contours rather than broad black silhouette fill.
remaining_limitations: The source atlas retains baked gradients, highlights and eye-region irregularities; this is not a freshly painted flat-color texture set.
The pale stocking-top band and small fragment-like silhouettes beside the lower legs are inherited from the source asset.
Dense curls and wing/tail connections have not been retopologized or separated into animation-ready parts.
Face shadow reduction is a conservative color/position estimate; it is not semantic face segmentation or a deformation-tested facial shader.
The character is still unrigged. Eevee material effects are not preserved by ordinary GLB material export.
